beats.text: Your fridge doesn't make cold. It pumps heat out.
The trick is a liquid that boils below freezing.
Inside, it boils in these coils, and soaks up heat from your food.
A compressor squeezes the gas, and makes it hot.
The coils at the back dump that heat into your kitchen, and it turns liquid again.
A tiny valve drops the pressure, and it's ice cold again.
Boil. Squeeze. Release. Expand. That's a fridge.
Which machine should we break down next?
